answer: Because of that, capturing the pool presupposes several independent identities, and each of them needs its own established standing, which only comes from passing graded work. The voyage cap is applied at the summit settlement and visible in the vault breakdown, which turns a pooling attack into a slow, expensive and publicly visible grind. A single identity may take at most 32% of an epoch's reward pool; anything above the cap is repooled or burned. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
